diagnosis.observed_CI_failure: Python 3.11.17 / NumPy 2.3.5 / Ubuntu 26.04 failed the original raw-float process SHA expectation.
diagnosis.controlled_reproduction: The identical CI fingerprint was reproduced under the original Python 3.12.14 by disabling NumPy AVX512/AVX2/FMA3 CPU features only. Thus Python sum version changes are not necessary to explain the physical-array hash mismatch. No claim is made that Python 3.11 aggregate metrics are bit-identical before CI reruns.
diagnosis.controlled_reproduction_exact: actions, full assignments, all task gaps, labels, alarm flags, event times, all reported metrics, interval boundaries, all public float32 history inputs and callback times

reference.generation: Captured from the ORIGINAL checkout only, after verifying every recorded source file SHA. All four captures reproduced the original migration receipt hashes and metrics exactly. No current-engine outputs were accepted as new expectations.

comparison_contract.reference_identity: SHA256 of the complete gzip fixture is pinned in the test, in addition to source commit and exact specification.
exact: full action log and action digest
full assignment digest, including route and dispatch times
every measurement target, task ID, role, access/calibration flag, alarm and transition
all event and anomaly interval boundary times
history age, measured/verified masks and coordinate feature columns
discrete event/interval scalar types, including Boolean versus integer

continuous_float64.scope: every original process-array value, every completed measurement value, every continuous aggregate metric, every anomaly weight

history_float32.scope: every public input value; discrete feature columns additionally require exact equality

comparison_contract.nonfinite: All reference values are finite; any NaN or infinity in actual values fails. No equal_nan behavior.
comparison_contract.diagnostics: Every case prints count, differing value count, maximum absolute and relative differences with array/field paths, maximum fraction of allowed error, and history ULP maximum. Diagnostics print even on numeric failure.
corruption_checks: Boolean alarm changed to equal-valued integer
comparison_contract.historical_hashes: Original physical, measurement and history byte hashes remain archived for source identity; they are not treated as portable equality assertions.
